<p>This includes access to powerful FFmpeg capabilities like duplicate frame detection, framerate interpolation, analytical tools, and deinterlacing with a number of filters available.</p>
<p>You don’t need to be an expert in encoding to use Shutter Encoder, but if you are, you’re going to appreciate the power it gives you!</p>

<p>You can even share those preset files with other users!</p>
</div></div></div></div></div>
